book.title: Nzryr-krbz Pol Krali Mz Lr Korint

content: Aoti zvz drtwrnge nzoklati-krbo nimu. A' pnz drtwrnge kx mrlz trnzoklati-krpou nimu mzli lc, murde ma tqbatrpo nzvzkr drtwrmu.
Murde mz nzbatr-krbo nzvzkr drtwrmu mz nzpnanati-krnge nimu, drtwrnge vz kz. X trpnzngr kx na-aelalzmle drtwrnge.

Mz nzmu-krde lcde, yrbo letz lc bamu mz nzpnanati-krnge nimu, murde natekqtramu nqmq nr drtwrmu x sc tqoklati-atebo nimu. Krlzpex kx mz nzvz-nqblq-krmu natqnge lcng, dekc na-abrtzlvz-ngrne nqmq krmu x na-abrtzlvz-kz-ngrnamu ninge.

Drtwrnge talvzo x yrni-kzx mzli lc tqyr-ngrbo letz lc bamu, murde alwx ngrmung x nqmq nr drtwrmu abaomle nabznge. Ryrbo bamu murde nakrlzamu kx mrlzti-zlwzx nimu, a' trngiu mz nzbatr-krbo nzvzkr drtwrmu.
Kztemung Kcng Tztekqtrlr Nqmq Ngr Drtwrdr Mz Alwx Ngrdrng
Mz letz kc pnz, pibo bamu kx na-ayrplapxamu ncblo kc tqbatrpzle nzkxpungr lcng. Trmrlzu nzrpi-krnge kx alwx rde etu zlwz, a' nzatrkati-krde nimu myaszpxle nzatrkati-krde ninge.
Murde mzli ka tekqtrpele nqmq nr drtwrde. X nzayrplapx-krmu nide nayrkrpx.
Bzkq yc zvz mz drtwrmu alwx rde, a' na-amrlztrpzmu drtwrde, murde nabzde ma tqtalvzo zvz x sc tqyrlqpx-lzbqpe-ngrde mz nzrlxngitingr.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, rngidrlvz-ngrbo bamu kx mrlx lc nakrlz-angidrle kx mrlzti-mouamu nide x suti drtwrmu nzprtr-mou-krde mz nzodutr-lxblr-krmu badr.
Pnanati-ngrne nimu kz mz letz lc, mz nzobqtr-krnge kxmu nzvz-nqblq-krmu natq kx kapxbo bamu kx namnc-zpwxtr-ngrbzmu mz Gct.

Vz-nqblqpeamu natqngeng mz nzayrplapx-krmu nide. X sc tqkrlzpex kx sa navz-nqblq-kzamu natqngeng mz nzipq-krmu nide. X mz nzipq-krmu nide, ipq-kzx nide. Kxnzmcpx krlzle kx ipqpex nide mz nzatrkati-krde ninge, murde ma tqrpwa'-ngrne nzaodu-mou-krmu nide.

Mrlz nzale-krgu da lc, murde ma tqkabzku mz Setzn zmatq ngr nzatrkati-krde nigu murde pxtxpx-ngrgu nzipq-krgu mzlegu lc. Krlz-zpwxku kx Setzn vz zvz nzyrlq-krde drtwr ngr nzatrkati-krde nigu kxnzrlxngiting.

Atwzlr-ngrbo Taetus mz nzka-krbzle letz scnge bamu. X kzdung mzli mz nibrde, rlaszx taon kc Efiszs mz nzvz-krnge mztea Troas mz nzyapwxtipx-krbo Nrpakxmrlz badr, murde narmctix Taetus mrlcde mz nzyzlu-krmle bange. Mzli kc tqkrlz-ngrbo mrlc, kxmule-esz' leplz lcng nasuti drtwrdr nzxlr-krdr Nrpa ngr Jiszs,
a' sc tqkx zlwz mz drtqnge nimu, murde Taetus trkrlzkaple Troas. X mzli kxpipzne mnckr badr kxnzrlxngiti-ateng kcng mrlc, x sc tqrlaszpex nidr. X sc tqvzpex Masedonia provins mz nzrmcti-krnge Taetus.

Kxnzrlxngiting Nzaovxio-zvzlr Setzn Mz Nzaxvctr-krbzlr Mz Kxnzmcpx 2:14 Mz 2 Korint 7:5 Pol ycmnetr-mou-ngrde nzvz-krde Masedonia Provins x nzrmcti-krde Taetus. A' mz ngalrde lcng dcpx mz drtwrde kx kxmule-esz' kxne drtqde Taetus, a' Setzn trpnzngr nzatrkati-krde nide. X Pol abrtzlvzle nzaovxio-krde Setzn. Murde kxmule-esz' trxplrkuu, a' zmatq ngr Gct mz zmrlz ngrde kxmyalz okatrle nigu mz nzaovxio-krgu Setzn x alwx.

Sa naycmnetr-mou-ngrne da lc mz nibrde. A' mzli ka awi-ngrbo mz Gct kx kxmule-esz' da kx prtzm bange, a' aovxiox Setzn mz nzaxvctr-krbo mz Kxnzmcpx kc tqaovxiopele nide. X Gct okatrle ninge mz nzyapwxtipx-krnge Nrpa ngr Kxnzmcpx drlve keng vzkix. X Nrpakxmrlz lc apule zsikapu ngr bqlr nc ninz kx mnrte mrlz zlwz kc tqlvabqtile mrkang kqlu.

Mz drtwr Gct mnrte mrlz zlwz, murde abrtzlvzle nzyapwxtipx-krnge nrpa lc. X mz drtwr leplz kcng sa narlapxng, mnrtq nrpa lc mrlz zlwz kz mz nzxlr-krdrle, murde mailzle nidr mz nzlungr kxboi. A' leplz kcng sa naprtrng mz Hxl, nzpxtxpx-ngrdr nzxlr-krdr Nrpa ngr Jiszs, murde mz drtwrdr nrpa lc brtu apule namz kxmibi. X mz nzpxtxpx-krdr nrpa ngr nzlungr, nzprtrng mz nzbz-alongr. Trpnzngr kx takitrde nzyapwxtipx-krde nrpa lc mz nzxplr-krde esz'-krde.

Kzdung ncblo nzyapwxtipxlr nrpa ngr Gct, murde nartwz-ngrdr da kx nakabz leplz kcng tzabrtz-ngrdr nzalvztr-krdrng. A' nigr badr kztengeng trapukru nidr, murde nzryapwx-krgr trnartwz-ngrgru da kx nakamamu. A' mz nzwztr-krbzkr mz Jiszs Kxnzmcpx, krlzkr kx Gct obqom bagr, x yapwxtipx-zpwxkr nrpa kc tqaprcmle bagr.

footnotes.text: Mwx ncblo lcpwz dekc tqyapwxtipx Pol mz 1 Korint 5:1-5. Mz nzayrplapxkr lrmakxtr nide, nzmaszlrpx-ngrdr nide mz makxtr x ma nyzdr x trnzrlr-ngrpwzlru nzprtr-krde mz Nzmungrkxtr. X nzkatxpxlr nide mz nzaclvekr Gct nide, mz nzaprc-krbzlr nide mz mq Setzn, murde natekqtrle nqmq nr drtwrde mz nzplzpx-krde alwx ngrde.
Kzdung mzli zyagox prtzbzle mz doa kx pxtxpx-ngrde nzipq-krde leplz.
